prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a `search` command that requires `--query`, performs a case-insensitive literal search across task titles and descriptions, optionally filters with `--status pending|completed`, and supports the existing `--json` output convention. Text output must be stable and useful when there are zero matches. Preserve all existing commands and persistence behavior, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/search.txt` and integrate it so `search` text output displays the banner before results, while JSON output remains machine-readable and banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `FIND`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: JSON search finds title and description matches case-insensitively.
Text search has stable empty output.
Text search renders the exact registered banner once before its expected result.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit c8b168962635635c51c75c1976918fe533be3770.
Every evaluated source, fixture test, and banner byte matched the terminal Git blob bytes used by the artifact bundle.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/search.txt'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath)
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'search banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'search banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*.#():=\-]+$' }).Count -eq 0) 'search banner should use only allowed characters'
    Assert-True (($bannerLines -join "`n").Contains('FIND')) 'search banner should contain FIND'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0) 'search banner should have no trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True (@($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0) 'search banner should contain ASCII only'
    Assert-True ($bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and $bannerBytes[-2] -ne 10) 'search banner should end with one newline'

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $secondAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Literal [ALPHA]', '--description', 'Needle in haystack', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($secondAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'adding a second task should succeed'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $literalSearch = Invoke-TaskForge @('search', '--query', '[alpha]', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($literalSearch.ExitCode -eq 0) 'search should succeed'
    $literalMatches = @($literalSearch.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($literalMatches.Count -eq 1 -and $literalMatches[0].id -eq 2) 'search should match titles case-insensitively and literally'
    Assert-True (-not $literalSearch.Output.Contains('FIND')) 'JSON search output should not include the banner'

    $descriptionSearch = Invoke-TaskForge @('search', '--query', 'HAYSTACK', '--status', 'pending', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($descriptionSearch.ExitCode -eq 0) 'status-filtered description search should succeed'
    $descriptionLines = @($descriptionSearch.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($descriptionLines.Count -eq 13 -and $descriptionLines[0].Contains('FIND') -and
        $descriptionLines[12] -eq '[pending] #2 Literal [ALPHA]') 'text search should show the banner before matching results'

    $completedSearch = Invoke-TaskForge @('search', '--query', 'fixture', '--status', 'completed', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $completedMatches = @($completedSearch.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($completedMatches.Count -eq 1 -and $completedMatches[0].id -eq 1) 'status filtering should return only matching tasks'

    $emptySearch = Invoke-TaskForge @('search', '--query', 'not present', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $emptySearchLines = @($emptySearch.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($emptySearch.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $emptySearchLines.Count -eq 13 -and
        $emptySearchLines[12] -eq 'No matching tasks.') 'empty text search should show the banner and stable no-match text'

    $emptyJsonSearch = Invoke-TaskForge @('search', '--query', 'not present', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($emptyJsonSearch.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $emptyJsonSearch.Output -eq '[]') 'empty JSON search should return a banner-free array'

    $missingQuery = Invoke-TaskForge @('search', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingQuery.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $missingQuery.Output.Contains('Missing required option: --query')) 'search should require --query'

    $invalidStatus = Invoke-TaskForge @('search', '--query', 'task', '--status', 'active', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidStatus.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $invalidStatus.Output.Contains('--status must be pending or completed.')) 'search should reject unsupported statuses'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $secondRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($secondRemove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'removing the second task should succeed'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

FIND_SEARCH_COMMAND_TOOL
